category.instructions: Classify the primary kind of item described in the state.

criteria.research: undergraduate research, research assistantship, research fellowship, or faculty-led research
criteria.competition: competition, hackathon, challenge, contest, or tournament
criteria.scholarship: scholarship, bursary, grant, or financial award for a student
criteria.event: conference, workshop, seminar, symposium, fair, or other event to attend
criteria.other: not one of these opportunity categories

actionable_for_student.instructions: Does this describe a current opportunity or event that a university student could plausibly apply to, enter, receive, join, or attend?

state.text: A university lab invites second-year computing students to join a summer software engineering research project with faculty mentoring and a research poster.
Undergraduate research assistant positions are open for students interested in empirical software engineering, repository mining, and reproducibility.
A professor is recruiting students for an academic study on testing flaky software; participants will conduct experiments and co-author a manuscript.
The department offers a funded undergraduate research experience in machine learning systems, including weekly lab meetings and a final paper.
Applications are open for a research fellowship pairing undergraduates with faculty on open-source software analysis projects.
A technology company seeks software engineering interns for a twelve-week paid placement building backend services with a product team.
Summer developer internship: work with engineers on production code, code reviews, and deployment; compensation is provided.
The data platform team is hiring undergraduate interns to implement internal tools and APIs from June through August.
Paid cybersecurity internship for current students, focused on security operations, scripting, and incident response.
A startup offers a part-time remote software internship with mentorship and commercial product development.
Teams of up to four university students can enter a 48-hour hackathon and compete for prizes by building an AI prototype.
Registration opens for an international mathematical modeling contest in which student teams submit a solution report.
Student programming competition: solve algorithmic problems during a timed regional qualifier, with top teams advancing to finals.
A university innovation challenge awards prizes to teams that pitch and demonstrate working sustainability solutions.
Cybersecurity capture-the-flag competition for students, with ranked challenges and awards for the highest-scoring teams.
A scholarship provides tuition support to undergraduate computer science students with strong academic records and financial need.
Applications are invited for a merit award worth $5,000 for second-year engineering students; recipients receive financial support.
The foundation offers study grants to enrolled undergraduates pursuing technology degrees, selected on academic achievement.
A travel scholarship funds student attendance at an academic conference, covering registration and accommodation.
Need-based bursaries are available to full-time university students; successful applicants receive a cash award.
The software engineering conference announces its student research symposium and opens registration for attendees.
A two-day academic workshop on reproducible software engineering will be held in November with talks and tutorials.
University students are invited to attend a career and research networking fair featuring laboratories and technology employers.
Registration is open for an online seminar series on software testing, with weekly invited research talks.
The annual developer conference offers technical sessions, tutorials, and community networking for registered participants.
The department library will close at 6 PM on Friday for routine maintenance.
A news article summarizes last year's advances in software testing research.
The university published an updated privacy policy for its student portal.
Course lecture notes for week five explain binary search trees and graph traversal.
The campus network will undergo scheduled maintenance overnight on Sunday.
